meta.name: i18n-parity
meta.description: MANDATORY for every coding agent and contributor touching localized content — keep all five localization surfaces (dashboard UI keys, wiki page, mirrored READMEs, locale-aware formatting, language switchers) in parity across every supported language. Use automatically (without being asked) whenever you add or change user-visible UI copy, add an i18n key, edit README.md, edit wiki/index.html, or change docs that the READMEs and wiki mirror — and use the full new-language checklist whenever adding a language (a new README-XX.md, a new client/src/i18n/locales/<xx>/ directory, or a new lang-option in the wiki).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让界面文案和文档在所有语言版本中同步更新
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在维护多语言产品,担心改一处忘记同步其他语言的翻译。
copy.tagline_en: Keep every UI string and doc updated in all supported languages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a localized product and worry about out-of-sync translations.

howto.what: 装上后,只要 Claude 改动界面文案、翻译键、README 或 wiki 等本地化内容,它会把所有支持语言(en、zh、vi、ko、es)对应的文件同步更新,并自动运行核查,确保仪表板、wiki、镜像 README、语言切换器和日期数字格式这五类界面保持一致。
howto.when: 当你新增或修改面向用户的界面文案、i18n 键、README.md、wiki/index.html 等会被镜像的文档,或为项目添加新语言(如新建 README-XX.md、locales/xx 目录)时,自动触发。

say.text: 我刚改了 README.md 新增一段,请同步到其余四种语言镜像。
say.note: Claude 会按镜像要求逐节更新。

say.text: 帮我新增翻译键 nav.home,所有语言文件都补上。
say.note: 它会核对键路径、类型和插值。

say.text: 运行 i18n 核查脚本和 wiki 测试,检查有没有漏译。
say.note: 脚本会指出具体文件和语言。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when Claude changes UI copy, i18n keys, README, or wiki, it updates all supported-language files (en, zh, vi, ko, es) in the same change and runs checks to keep dashboard UI, wiki, mirrored READMEs, switchers, and formatting aligned.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you add/change user-facing UI copy, add an i18n key, edit README.md or wiki/index.html, change mirrored docs, or add a new language (new README-XX.md, locales/<xx>/ directory, or wiki language option).

say_en.text: I just added a section to README.md. Sync the other four language mirrors.
say_en.note: It updates each mirrored README section by section.

say_en.text: Add a new i18n key 'nav.home' — fill it in every locale file.
say_en.note: It verifies key path, type, and interpolation tokens.

say_en.text: Run the i18n audit script and wiki tests to check for missing translations.
say_en.note: The script names the exact file and locale.
